sanskrit: dvimārgāvasthitaṃ dhyāyet pūjāgnau homavittamaḥna jātirūpaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ tatsūkṣmaṃ parikīrtitamsandhyā tu viṣuvaṃ proktaṃ vuttareṇa * * * * ?dakṣiṇenottaraṃ vidyāṃ madhye tu viṣuvaṃ bhavetviṣuvaṃ tu vijānīyāt puṇyamantro bhayātmakamiḍākhyāntargatāṃ dhyāyet pitṛyāne śikhiddhvajapiṃgalāntargataṃ dhyāyed devayānaṃ taducyatesuṣumnāntargataṃ dhyāyed viṣuve ca vicakṣaṇaḥyogapīṭhaṃ ca padmaṃ ca praṇavena tu vinyasetvyāpayanti madhaścordhvaṃ punaḥ śakti niyojayetpūrakeṇa śikhāntasthaṃ śivabījamayaṃparamamṛte vā plāvyamānamupariṣṭāt samaṃ tataḥyathā bhavati tatvena tacchṛṇuṣva yathākramamīśānādīni brahmāṇi kaniṣṭhādiṣu yojayetprāsādaṃ vinyaset pañcadvyāpinaṃ sarvatomukhamīśānaṃ pañcadhā mūrdhni vaktraṃvaktra catuṣṭayehṛdādyaṃgairaghoraṃ tu guhyavāmaṃ prakalpayethṛdi śrīvātadānau ca nābhyāṃ ca jaṭhare tathāguhye caiva tathāliṅge ūrvorvaijānunostathāpādayorhastayoścaiva nāsāyāṃ śirasā tathānetraṃ netreṣu vinyasya punaraṃgāni yojayetśikhāyāṃ tu śikhādyā tu kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥśivasya yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tādṛśaṃ cintayātmaniyathāntardeha vinyāsastathā bāhyepi ṣaṇmukhatathā vai śiṣya dehe tu agnau home tathaiva ca

sanskrit: sarvakāmapradaṃ guhyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ paramśivībhūtaḥ supūtātmā śivasyārcanamārabhetvighnānuccāṭayet sthūlāt tālaśabda trayeṇa tupunarāveṣṭayenmantrī tatsthānaṃ kavacena tuvajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ tathāṃkuśamaindrī diśaṃ samārabhya yāvadīśānagocaramgandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpaiḥ punarastrāṇi pūjayetvyāpayanti hyadhaścordhvamaprameyāṃ manaupamāmsa bāhyābhyantaraṃ paścāt kavacenāvakuṇṭhayettritatvaṃ vinyaset tasmin punaḥ śaktiṃ niyojayetgandhapuṣpasamāyuktaṃ tajjalaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtamaṅgairaṅgīkṛtaṃ vatsa śuddhasphaṭikanirmalamaprokṣitaṃ na tā divyaṃ bhaviṣyatvaṃ ca vai śivedharmādi cāstraparyantaṃ śivavarja ṣaḍānanasaṃpūrṇāhuti dāne ca sarvakarma samarpaṇeāgneyaṃ diśamāśritya vidikṣu praṇavena tuyogapīṭhaṃ tataḥ paścācchaktinālaṃ ca paṅkajamtribhāgakeparākīrṇaṃ śaktijālavitānitambalapramathanī sarvabhūtadamanī manonmanīhṛdayena tu vinyasya kesareṣu daleṣu caīśānaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu śivavyoma prakalpayetsitavarṇanibhaṃ dhyātvā pūrvavaktre tu pudgalamsadyaḥ paścima bhāge tu tatohyāvāhanaṃ bhavetaghoreṇa tu sānnidhyamarghyaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tuvarṇarūpaka saṃyuktaṃ punaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpayet

sanskrit: snāpayet sadya bījena kavacena vilepayetīśānena tu puṣpāṇi makuṭaṃ kuṇḍalāni caaghoreṇa pradātavyaṃ dhūpaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tugandhapuṣpāṇi dhūpañca dīpaṃ cātra pradāpayetnivedyārghyaṃ tu devasya tato mudrāṃ pradarśayetcoṭikā mudrāḥ tataḥ padmaḥ liṅgañca dravyarūpiṇigandhadigdhau karau kṛtvā mudrāṃ samyak prapūjayetmukheṣvācamanīyañca śirassvarghyaṃ nidhojayetvisarjane tṛtīyantu devasyārghyaṃ prakalpayetmadhye caiva tu mantrajñaḥ pañcasvarghyaṃ niyojayetūrdhvavaktre tu dātavyaṃ samukhaṃ ca parāṅmukhamvisarjane tu gāṅgeyaṃ deyamarghyaṃ parāṅmukhambhakṣyā bhojyānna pānādi lehyaśoṣyānyanekaśaḥpunarāvaṇairdattyāt naivedyaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtamśāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā kṛtvā bhūtabaliṃ haretdadyādbhūtabaliṃ mantrī sarvapākavimiśritampraviśyāyatanaṃ paścāt japaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥprāṇāyāmaiḥ śikhāṃsthayekaṃcittaḥ sadā japetsvastikaṃ vāsanaṃ baddhvā samakāyaśiraḥ sthitaḥacirātsiddhimāpnoti adaitadaitamāśritaḥāśrayaṃ sarvasiddhīnāmihāmutraphalapradamtatastvāveṣṭayet paścāt kavacena yathākramampunaracyukṣaṇaṃ paścāt kavacena vidhānavittataḥ śaktiṃ nyaset tasmin taṭitsahasrasannibhāmcatuddhvaḥ svarasaṃbhinno vahnibījordhvadīpitaḥ

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpa savitrādhyairvastrālaṃkāra vāhanaiḥevaṃ niveditātmā tu gurupāśairvimucyateyuṣmadīyo vikalpena śaṃsyavālyaśca te sadāanujñāto yadā tena kuryāt kāryāṇi suvrataḥvṛthā teṣāṃ vijānīyāt gururyeṣāṃ na devatāgurostu na paraṃ kiñcidityāha bhagavān śivaḥajñānatimirākrānte tasmājjñānamayo hi saḥprāpnuvanti samāyukta guruṇoktena karmaṇātasmādādau guruḥ proktaḥ paścād devo niraṃjanaḥtasmānnāstatra boddhavyaḥ gurubhyaḥ parato guhatoṣito nātrasandehastathā devāssavāsavāḥtasmādevaṃ viditvā tu guruṃ naivāvamānayetāsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ narohedgurusannidhaucitrāṃ naivāgrato dhāryaṃ noṣṇaṃṣaṃ na ca pādukenādhyāpanaṃ prakurvīta vyākhyānaṃ śiṣyasaṃgrahamna śrotavyā gurornindā śāstranindā tathaiva cagurorjyeṣṭhaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ vā bhrātaraṃ na vyati krametdīkṣābhiṣeka jyeṣṭhena kaniṣṭhasya kadācanasarvato guravo jñeyā ye cānye pūrvadīkṣitāḥmānyāḥ pūjyāśca te nityaṃ guravonyatra ṣaṇmukhakālenānta sthito yasya tasya mokṣāḥ kathaṃ bhavetkiṃ kiṃcid vidyate karma tasya dharmokṣa sādhanammṛtasyāpi varaṃ skanda dīkṣākarma vidhīyateapi kalpamati kuryād ekaścitta samāhitaḥuccārya vinyasen mantrī darbhai putnīśake kṛte

sanskrit: saṃsthāpya dakṣiṇe pārśve tasya nāma hṛdi nyasetsammantrya pañcagavyena kṛtvā tasmin niyojayettadevālambhanaṃ kṛtvā tasmāt saṃhṛtya homayetvinyaset sarvatatvāni tatvairdevā na tu kramātśāntīṃ ca niṣkale sthāne dhyātvā sarvānidho mukhāttatrāstathasya saṃlīna vinyasecchaktimaṇḍalamaṣṭau vidyeśvarān mantrī grīvāyāṃ bāhu saṃdhiṣukalāmurasisaṃsthāpya hṛdaye nīlalohitamrāgopi rañjakastasya vidya prabodha lakṣmaṇaiḥśabda sparśaṃ ca rūpañca rasogandhaśca pañcamaḥnābhi meḍhrāntare buddhi mahaṅkṛtiśca sandhiṣutatraiva yojayed vāyuṃ guhyādguhyāṣṭakāvṛtamtasyādho vāruṇaṃ tatvaṃ yāvadhā jānumaṇḍalaḥlokādau vinyased devān brahma viṣṇu maheśvarāncintayet saptapātāla narakāṃstu tala sthitausthāpayitvā vidhānena punarabhyarcayet kramātpādādārabhya tān sarva aṃsau saṃsthāpya śodhayetkalpayitvā yathā pūrvaṃ paśuṃ saṃhṛtya yojayettatvātu sarvatatveṣu tathā saṃyojayecchivekṛtvāgnau homayet paścāt tāṃ tu puttalakāṃ budhaḥvyomānilānalāmbhorvīḥ pañcatatvāni yojayetkalābhirvyāpitāstāṃśca śānti śṛṇyādibhiḥ kramātvyāpta sadāśivaṃ tatvaṃ śāntayā vāyurūpayāavyaktādyāvadaṃbhoṃtaṃ vyāpta caiva pratiṣṭhayāvyāpitaṃ saharudraiśca dhmātacākerā bhayam

sanskrit: kālātmakaṃ tadā devaṃ mṛtyurūpaṃ vicintayetjvalajjvalana saṃkāśaṃ dīptateja śikhārcitamkālā ju * samādhāya manasā niścalendriyaḥsantāḍyā vāyuvegena kṣurikāstreṇa mūrdhanievaṃ vimucyate prāṇaiḥ tasminneva prakī * tetasmādbindumupāsīta śaktisnarasa * * *vittahīnaṃ cared bhikṣāṃ kaṇapatvāṃ na kīmathabhojanaṃ śayanaṃ śaucamāyāmañca japāśrayamkṣālayitvāstra bījena kavacena tu veṣṭayetastraṃ tu japato nityaṃ bhikṣāmāvayecchuciḥtato bhikṣāmaṭennityaṃ patitā śastavarjitāmsaṃgṛhya mūrtikāṃ bhūyo jaṃghā śaucaṃ tu kārayetśodhayitvā vidhānena devāgnyātmani kalpayetsnigdhamalpaṃ ca bhuñjīta bhaviṣya śītalaṃ niśiuddhūlya punarācamya * yīta vidhinā tataḥsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇo punarā kṛtvā japālayamrudrāvatāra kriḍādyaiścitra karma vibhūṣitamprāguta kalpakanaṃ kuryācchayanaṃ ca sadā budhaḥdvāra deśādārabhya veṣṭayet triguṇena tuaṃgān svasthān vinyasthān pūjayitvā yathā kramātśivasthāne yajed rudraṃ pa * dhyānena vā guhaśastrodyatakaraṃ ghoraṃ sarvavighna vināśanamsvaracakraṃ tato dadyād varṇāni ca yathākramamśayītamanasā yogī śivaṃ paśyet samaṃ tataḥardharātre tu savane tathaiva samupāsayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00327 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gatiṃ devasya vijñāya japadhyānādikaṃ kramātmanasā vartayet taṃ tu praṇavaṃ bindu varjitambahiraṃgo pavītī ca dṛṣṭidūta padakramīardharātre tu nair-ṛtye dve sandhye tu yathā divātato malaṃ prakurvīta vastrataścāvakuṃṭhitaḥna gulme śādvale praśmeśānopa vaneṣu cagrahītaśigno bhūtvā tu mṛttikā haraṇaṃ kuruvalmīka mṛttikāṃ caiva tathā vai grāmayānikāmtataḥ śaucaṃ prakurvīta mṛttikāṃ gṛhya vāriṇāmubhayoḥ saptatātapya mṛttikā śuddhimicchatādanta kāṣṭhaṃ tato mantrī bhakṣayedabhimantritampaścādyojaṃ dhyānaṃ yāvadabhyudito radhiḥathordhvaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ sarvakāma samṛddhayesāvanaṃ paramaṃ skanda lepa gandha vināśanamupaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā śivaṃ dhyāyet sa nirmalammanayitāstra bījena hṛdayena tu saṃharetastreṇa kṣālayet pūrvaṃ sthāpayeddhṛdayena tupūrvadakṣiṇe naiva tathā caivottareṇa tuuttaraṃ śiva japtaṃ tu prakurvīta pṛthak pṛthaknārācāstra prayogeṇa toya madhye punaḥ kṣipetśivajaptena bhāgena tatobhyāvartayejjalekaṃthayitvā tataḥ snāyāt śivatīrthasya madhyataḥbrahmāṅgaiḥ śiva gāyatryā mahāstreṇa śivena casaṃhṛtyasarvamantrāṇi ninādena vidhānavittata āyatanaṃ gacchet puṣpahasto vicakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00327 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāṇi pādau tu bhasmasnānaṃ samācaretsarvajñā * ttomaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ paramadhaḥ parisantyajya pañcagavyena mardayetprakṣavalmīka nirmukte pravāte pariśoṣayetśivāgniṃ janayitvā tu nirdahet tena vahnināpañcagavyena saṃyuktaṃ vidhānena tu nirdahetśuci sthānāśritaṃ śuddhaṃ tadapyevaṃ punardahetastraṃ tu japato mantrī sarvavighnavināśanamvidhisnānaṃ tataḥ paścāt mūrdhna ārabhya mantravitabhiṣekaṃ śive naiva paścāt kūrvita ṣaṇmukhaprakṣālya tu mṛdā pādau karau ca punarācametparimṛjyānmukhaṃ śaktyā trivāraṃ tu yathākramamācamya vidhinā bhūyaḥ pitṛdevāśca tarpayettato dhyānaṃ prakurvita japañca trividhaṃ punaḥkālye ca madhyame caiva prāsādādi krameṇa tuprāṇavṛtti nirodhena naiva pāpamavāpnuyātśatamaṣṭottaramakṣaissarva pāpa viśuddhayeastrāṇi ghorūpāṇi satataṃ parivartayetsaṃsāyayedrudrānmantrānyogi yogātmakān guṇān* * hā yo yogī siddhiṃ kamaṇḍalu dharassadāataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kamaṇḍaludharassadāprajvalyamagniṃ ghoreṇāstreṇa ca vidhānavittāmramyena saṃśodhya tathāstrodaka bhasmanātatastvā pūrayet paścād vastrapūtena vāriṇāna kiñcit saṃspṛśet tāvad yāvacchuṣkau karāvubhau
